purpose: DSV41_KV_LAYOUT=v41c: ratio-1/2 compressed latents as V4.1 FP4 records (288 B), SWA unchanged (V4, 584 B)

changes.change: dsv41 indexed writer: scale = e4m3(clamp(amax * f32(1/6), 2^-9, 448)), values div.rn by the decoded scale (was amax / 6.0 and a rounded reciprocal), so the record is the model's own fake_quant_compressed_kv rounding
pack_deepseek_v41_cache_reference indexed: the same model arithmetic

status: REFERENCE / TEST ONLY (coordinator, 2026-10-27): production v41c writes the compressed records with SGLang's own c1/c2 / fused_store_cache V41_FP4 path in SGLang's page ABI (data rows then a per-page e4m3 footer); b12x_next's deepseek_v41 writer and readers use contiguous token records and are not on the serving path. The aligned writer arithmetic stays as an independent reference of the model's rounding (tests/test_v41_kv_numerics.py) and for any future b12x_next reader work.
